summary: Approved. Both feet sit on the floor for all 25 frames (lowest z 0.00 on every frame, floating 0, penetration 0, slide 0) and the hover from iteration 1 is gone (ly flat at -0.03). Coil at f4-5, 3-frame strike (66/131/117 deg per frame), moving hold f9-12 and eased recovery all read. The 15 accel spikes and 10 velocity corners are all on f4-9, i.e. the start and stop of the strike on the arm, chest and hips, and read as the intended snap. Only polish remains.

findings.observation: All four leg channels are constant (motion range 0) and the root height is flat, so the lower body never loads or drives the punch; the weight shift is carried only by the hip and chest twist. A small front-knee dip on the wind-up would add weight. Polish only.
